The surface enforces 1800 characters, offers the six recovered Audio Lab voices, computes deterministic SHA-256 message ids, checks cache before generation, exposes truthful audio/cache/error state, and explicitly discloses remote Supabase/Qwen3-TTS/Hugging Face generation. No existing Audio Lab or authority pointer was changed.
